films.title: The journey
films.what: 60 s. Sketch, clean cut, ink, stone, glaze, cloth, pop, a napkin cat, one mark.

films.title: The mark
films.what: The Apple one. Ink on white, then the Y becomes the icon.

films.title: Ink
films.what: Meok blooms into hanji. Gayageum logo.

films.title: Stone
films.what: Pressed into oat stone, the light walks across.

films.title: Glaze
films.what: The glaze cracks, a light sweeps.

films.title: Pop
films.what: Stickers slap down, the foil turns.
